classification: retrospective robustness audit of frozen external predictions; no refitting or external target-aware selection
question: Does the external PCHP advantage over the matched constant-offset comparator depend on one dataset or on a particular aggregation rule?
record_identity_note: target_cycle_number is not a unique record key: MULTISTAGE_50E contains two distinct diagnostic records at one nominal target cycle; the frozen table row is retained as the record unit

primary_comparison.estimand: mean across datasets of within-dataset cell-equal MAE differences
primary_comparison.test: two-sided exact sign-flip test over all 2^6 dataset-level sign assignments
primary_comparison.null: dataset-level paired effects are sign-symmetric around zero

secondary_comparator.role: descriptive sensitivity; exact p-value reported without multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory interpretation

sensitivity_estimands: dataset-equal mean after removing the dataset largest by cell count
dataset-equal mean after removing the dataset largest by record count

interpretation_rule.ROBUST: primary mean is negative, exact two-sided p <= 0.05, every leave-one-dataset-out primary estimate is negative, and both largest-dataset removals are negative
interpretation_rule.QUALIFIED: primary mean is negative but at least one robustness condition fails

stop_rule: Retain all six frozen datasets and both comparators. Do not retrain, tune, remove additional datasets, or change the primary aggregation after outcome inspection.
